Subject: March 30th Rail Switch Over




Shane,

On Saturday, March 30th, Ironclad will switch over the rail logistics from Tasman Ridge to Coral at the Pilbara Hub terminal.

To complete the switchover, we’ll need a Tasman Ridge technical rep at Pilbara Hub to assist and safeguard Tasman Ridge’s equipment and interests.

Please arrange for a Tasman Ridge technical representative to arrive by 12:00 noon, March 30th, at the Main Entrance of Pilbara Hub and ask for Ironclad’s Ronald Martin. Jorge is managing all switch operations.

If you have any questions, contact me or Ronald Martin at +61 8 9216 6911, ext 2511.

Thanks and best regards.

Howard
